name: Black Beans
siboNotes: Black beans are high in galacto-oligosaccharides (GOS) which feed SIBO bacteria. During elimination phase, stick to very small portions (2 tablespoons) or avoid entirely.
preparationTips: Rinse and drain canned beans thoroughly to reduce FODMAP content
Start with very small portions and increase gradually during reintroduction
Soaking dried beans overnight and discarding soaking water may reduce GOS content
Combine with digestive spices like cumin, ginger, or fennel seeds
alternatives: Eggs or chicken for complete protein
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of magnesium and potassium
